stories.title: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
stories.why: AI agents like Meta's Muse could change how many businesses operate, so small business owners may want to watch whether these tools become a threat or an opportunity for them.

stories.title: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain
stories.why: An AI agent choosing and delivering a gene therapy in a lab hints at how future medical research, and eventually the treatments people receive, could be shaped by AI.

stories.title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
stories.why: The closure of a privacy-focused assistant is a reminder that people who care about their data have fewer choices as the AI assistant market gets more crowded.
